Magic Keyboard: swipe up for Mission Con.en: Magic Keyboard: swipe up for Mission Control, down for app windows, and left or right to switch spaces. Changes apply at the next Virtual Mac start.
Magic Keyboard: swipe up for Mission Con.zh_CN: 妙控键盘：上滑显示 Mission Control，下滑显示应用窗口，左右滑动切换桌面空间。更改在下一次启动虚拟机时生效。
Magic Keyboard: swipe up for Mission Con.zh_TW: 巧控鍵盤：上滑顯示 Mission Control，下滑顯示 App 視窗，左右滑動切換桌面空間。更改在下一次啟動虛擬機時生效。
